description: This file defines the configuration class for the OpenID Authentication Plugin within the OrangeHRM system. It implements the PluginConfigurationInterface, uses a trait for service container management, and registers a social media authentication service during initialization.

classes.name: OpenidAuthenticationPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for the OpenID authentication plugin, responsible for registering necessary services during plugin initialization.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin configuration by registering the social media authentication service in the container.
